mapper.select: select coalesce(source_order.order_no, child_order.order_no) as order_no, source_order.order_no as source_order_no, child_order.order_no as child_order_no, case when s.source_member_id = #{memberId} then '发起商户' else '接收商户' end as role_name, s.settlement_amount, s.express_amount, s.compensation_amount, s.settlement_status, date_format(s.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time, date_format(s.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as update_time, s.remark from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_settlement s inner join ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance a on a.tenant_id = s.tenant_id and a.alliance_order_id = s.alliance_order_id and a.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_order source_order on source_order.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and source_order.member_id = a.source_member_id and source_order.order_id = a.source_order_id and source_order.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_order child_order on child_order.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and child_order.member_id = a.target_member_id and child_order.order_id = a.child_order_id and child_order.is_delete = 0 where s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and s.is_delete = 0 and (s.source_member_id = #{memberId} or s.receiver_member_id = #{memberId}) and s.settlement_status = #{status} and s.create_time >= #{beginTime} and s.create_time <= #{endTime} order by s.create_time desc, s.settlement_id desc limit 200
